season_core.main_question: Why can Aarav awaken the sealed legacy connected to Karna?
season_core.secondary_question: Why is someone trying to bring Karna's legacy and a separate divine weapon tradition connected to Lakshmana into the same conflict?
season_core.main_emotional_arc: Aarav begins as an ordinary young man, loses the life he knew, searches for the truth and gradually accepts responsibility for a power he never asked for.
season_core.main_threat: Malik is searching for ancient divine resonance sites while Unit Seven secretly tracks the same phenomenon.
season_core.season_rule: Do not reveal every mystery in Season 1. Each answer should naturally uncover a larger question.

episodes.title: The Golden Shield
episodes.purpose: Destroy Aarav's ordinary life and introduce the central mystery.
plot: A violent storm hits Dehradun while Aarav experiences an unexplained burning sensation around his sun-shaped birthmark.
Aarav lives with Vasu, Yashoda and Jaya and initially appears to be an ordinary 21-year-old.
Acharya Vedant notices unusual signs near an ancient temple and senses that something dormant has awakened.
A mysterious black vehicle connected to Unit Seven is seen monitoring the area.
Armed attackers arrive searching for something Vasu has secretly protected for years.
During the attack, Yashoda and Jaya are killed.
Vasu sacrifices himself while trying to save Aarav.
When Aarav is about to die, an unstable golden shield suddenly manifests around him.
The attackers retreat after witnessing the phenomenon.
Among the fragments left behind, Aarav discovers his first clue: the name Malik.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav changes from an ordinary young man into a traumatized survivor searching for answers.
episodes.power_progression: First involuntary manifestation of the golden defensive energy.
episodes.major_reveal: Vasu had been hiding knowledge connected to Aarav.
episodes.cliffhanger: Far away, Acharya Vedant looks toward the storm and says that the sealed door has opened.

episodes.title: The Name Malik
episodes.purpose: Begin Aarav's investigation and establish that powerful groups are watching him.
plot: Aarav wakes after the attack with fragmented memories of the golden shield.
Authorities cannot explain several unusual traces found at the destroyed location.
Aarav secretly keeps the clue containing Malik's name.
He discovers that Vasu maintained a hidden compartment containing an old map and coded notes.
Unknown surveillance teams begin following Aarav.
Aarav attempts to locate Acharya Vedant after finding his name inside Vasu's notes.
A Unit Seven operative observes Aarav but deliberately allows him to leave.
episodes.character_progression: Grief begins turning into determination.
episodes.power_progression: No controlled power use.
episodes.cliffhanger: Aarav reaches Vedant's temple, where Vedant addresses him by name before Aarav introduces himself.

episodes.title: The Keeper
episodes.purpose: Introduce Vedant and the idea that ancient divine forces survived.
plot: Aarav confronts Vedant and demands answers about Vasu.
Vedant reveals that Vasu belonged to a quiet network protecting ancient knowledge.
He refuses to explain Aarav's connection to the golden energy because he does not fully understand it himself.
Vedant shows Aarav records describing rare events called Divine Resonance.
Aarav initially rejects the supernatural explanation.
An intruder enters the temple searching for Vasu's map.
Aarav instinctively produces a brief flash of golden protection.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav begins reluctantly trusting Vedant.
episodes.power_progression: Second involuntary manifestation lasting only seconds.
episodes.major_reveal: The phenomenon affecting Aarav has appeared in ancient records.
episodes.cliffhanger: Vedant sees the golden pattern and recognizes a symbol associated with an ancient solar legacy.

episodes.title: Echo of the Sun
episodes.purpose: Connect the mystery symbolically to Karna without explaining everything.
plot: Vedant studies the pattern produced by Aarav's power.
Ancient manuscripts contain descriptions associated with protection, sacrifice and solar energy.
The clues point toward traditions surrounding Karna's Kavach and Kundal.
Vedant makes clear that Aarav is not being identified as Karna's reincarnation.
Aarav discovers Vasu had visited a remote archaeological site months before the attack.
Aarav and Vedant decide to investigate the site.
Unit Seven intercepts communications related to their journey.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav starts accepting that his family's secret is larger than he imagined.
episodes.power_progression: Aarav begins attempting to understand what triggers the shield.
episodes.major_reveal: The golden phenomenon appears connected to a fictional surviving legacy associated with Karna.
episodes.cliffhanger: General Rahman receives Aarav's photograph and orders his team not to harm him.

episodes.title: Unit Seven
episodes.purpose: Introduce General Rahman and create uncertainty about Unit Seven.
plot: Aarav and Vedant travel toward the archaeological site.
A Unit Seven team intercepts them.
Aarav assumes the organization was responsible for his family's deaths.
General Rahman meets Aarav for the first time.
Rahman claims Unit Seven was monitoring the attackers rather than assisting them.
He refuses to reveal everything he knows about Malik.
The meeting is interrupted by an attack from unidentified mercenaries.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav learns that the conflict may involve more than two sides.
episodes.power_progression: The shield briefly protects another person for the first time.
episodes.major_reveal: Unit Seven and Malik appear to be opposing forces.
episodes.cliffhanger: Rahman tells Aarav that Malik has been searching for him since before Aarav knew Malik existed.

episodes.title: The First Seal
episodes.purpose: Reveal the first physical piece of the ancient mystery.
plot: The group reaches a concealed chamber beneath the archaeological site.
Ancient markings react faintly to Aarav's presence.
Vedant determines that the chamber was designed to protect something rather than imprison it.
Aarav experiences fragmented visions but cannot understand whether they are memories or resonance effects.
They discover an empty pedestal showing that an artifact was removed recently.
Evidence suggests Malik reached the chamber before them.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav realizes revenge alone will not solve the mystery.
episodes.power_progression: Aarav intentionally triggers a tiny spark of golden energy for the first time.
episodes.major_reveal: Malik is collecting physical components connected to ancient resonance sites.
episodes.cliffhanger: A second symbol is found beside the solar markings, and Vedant recognizes that it belongs to a completely different ancient tradition.

episodes.title: Two Legacies
episodes.purpose: Introduce the second mythological axis.
plot: Vedant investigates the second symbol.
The evidence leads toward traditions connected to Lakshmana and a lost divine weapon lineage.
Vedant is disturbed because the two traditions should have no reason to appear together.
Rahman reveals that Unit Seven has discovered similar paired symbols at other sites.
Aarav begins basic physical and mental training to control his reactions.
A hidden observer reports Aarav's progress to Malik.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav begins training because he wants control rather than greater power.
episodes.power_progression: Basic defensive manifestation becomes slightly more repeatable.
episodes.major_reveal: Someone has deliberately connected two separate divine legacies.
episodes.cliffhanger: Malik receives the report and says that Aarav has finally begun opening the path.

episodes.title: Resonance
episodes.purpose: Define the limitations of the power system.
plot: Vedant teaches Aarav that divine resonance responds to intent rather than anger alone.
Aarav repeatedly fails while trying to summon the shield.
Memories of his family cause him to lose emotional control.
A dangerous training incident nearly injures Vedant.
Aarav finally activates the shield while protecting someone rather than himself.
The effort leaves him physically exhausted.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav understands that protection, not rage, is central to his legacy.
episodes.power_progression: First deliberate defensive activation.
episodes.major_reveal: The power responds differently depending on Aarav's intention.
episodes.cliffhanger: Unit Seven detects a massive resonance pulse from somewhere deep in the Himalayas.

episodes.title: The Himalayan Signal
episodes.purpose: Expand the scale of the story.
plot: Aarav, Vedant and a Unit Seven team travel toward the source of the Himalayan pulse.
The expedition encounters environmental anomalies and malfunctioning electronics.
Aarav begins sensing the direction of the resonance without equipment.
They discover ruins hidden inside a mountain passage.
Someone has recently entered the supposedly untouched ruins.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav begins functioning as part of a team despite distrusting Unit Seven.
episodes.power_progression: Passive sensitivity to divine resonance emerges.
episodes.major_reveal: Divine resonance can affect modern technology.
episodes.cliffhanger: Inside the ruins they find a wall covered with recent blood beside an ancient sealed doorway.

episodes.title: Behind the Door
episodes.purpose: Deliver the mid-season escalation.
plot: The group attempts to understand the sealed doorway.
Aarav's presence activates part of the mechanism.
Malik's operatives attack the expedition.
Aarav is forced into his first extended supernatural confrontation.
The doorway partially opens during the battle.
Inside is not a weapon but an ancient mechanism designed to locate other resonance sites.
Malik's operatives steal a key component.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav chooses to continue the mission despite having an opportunity to escape.
episodes.power_progression: Longer shield duration but severe exhaustion afterward.
episodes.major_reveal: The ancient sites form a connected network.
episodes.cliffhanger: The stolen component activates and projects the location of several dormant sites across India.

episodes.title: The Network
episodes.purpose: Reveal the scale of Malik's plan.
plot: Unit Seven analyzes the partial map of resonance sites.
Vedant believes the network was deliberately separated centuries ago.
Aarav discovers Vasu had marked one of the same locations in his private notes.
Evidence suggests Vasu knew the network might reactivate.
Rahman admits Unit Seven has secretly studied the phenomenon for years.
Aarav accuses Rahman of withholding information that could have saved his family.
episodes.character_progression: Trust between Aarav and Rahman deteriorates.
episodes.power_progression: No major new ability.
episodes.major_reveal: Vasu was preparing for the network's reactivation.
episodes.cliffhanger: A hidden file reveals Vasu once worked directly with Unit Seven.

episodes.title: Vasu's Secret
episodes.purpose: Reframe Aarav's understanding of his father figure.
plot: Rahman reveals portions of Vasu's history with Unit Seven.
Vasu left after disagreeing with experiments involving ancient artifacts.
He believed certain powers should remain sealed.
Aarav discovers that Vasu's decision to leave was connected to protecting him.
Vedant suspects Vasu knew Aarav would eventually trigger a resonance event.
A surviving recording from Vasu is discovered.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav struggles with anger toward Vasu while understanding the sacrifices made to protect him.
episodes.power_progression: Emotional instability temporarily weakens Aarav's control.
episodes.major_reveal: Vasu deliberately hid Aarav from organizations studying divine resonance.
episodes.cliffhanger: In the recording Vasu warns Aarav: 'Malik is not the beginning of this war.'

episodes.title: The Broken Weapon
episodes.purpose: Advance the Lakshmana-linked mystery.
plot: Clues from Vasu's recording lead to another hidden site.
The site contains fragments associated with the second divine weapon tradition.
The fragments appear damaged deliberately.
Vedant concludes that someone in the past separated the weapon's components to prevent its use.
Malik's operatives arrive searching for the largest fragment.
Aarav must protect the fragment without fully understanding its purpose.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav begins protecting the larger world rather than pursuing only personal revenge.
episodes.power_progression: The shield can briefly expand to cover multiple people.
episodes.major_reveal: The second legacy is incomplete and Malik is trying to reconstruct it.
episodes.cliffhanger: One fragment reacts to Aarav's golden energy even though Vedant believes the two powers should be incompatible.

episodes.title: Impossible Resonance
episodes.purpose: Deepen the central mystery surrounding Aarav.
plot: Unit Seven conducts non-invasive tests on the fragment.
The artifact remains inactive for everyone except Aarav.
Rahman becomes increasingly concerned about Aarav's unique resonance.
Vedant argues that Aarav should not be treated as an experiment.
Aarav experiences another fragmented vision involving two different forms of divine energy.
Malik secretly receives data from inside Unit Seven.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav becomes suspicious that someone within Unit Seven is helping Malik.
episodes.power_progression: No new controlled ability.
episodes.major_reveal: There is a traitor or information leak inside Unit Seven.
episodes.cliffhanger: Malik receives Aarav's confidential resonance data almost immediately after the test.

episodes.title: The Traitor
episodes.purpose: Turn the conflict inward.
plot: Rahman begins secretly investigating Unit Seven personnel.
Aarav and Vedant conduct their own investigation.
False evidence initially points toward an innocent operative.
Malik uses the confusion to launch an operation against a secured artifact facility.
Aarav realizes the internal leak was designed to distract them.
The true informant escapes before being identified completely.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav begins thinking strategically rather than reacting emotionally.
episodes.power_progression: Improved control during a short combat sequence.
episodes.major_reveal: Malik has had access to Unit Seven intelligence for years.
episodes.cliffhanger: Security footage shows the escaping informant meeting a figure wearing Malik's distinctive damaged ring.

episodes.title: Malik
episodes.purpose: Give Aarav his first direct encounter with Malik without revealing everything.
plot: Aarav follows the trail left by the informant.
He enters an abandoned underground complex against Rahman's orders.
Malik finally speaks directly to Aarav.
Malik claims Vasu and Unit Seven both hid the truth about Aarav.
He deliberately avoids explaining Aarav's origin.
Aarav attacks after Malik mentions his family.
Malik easily manipulates the environment and forces Aarav into retreat without revealing his full abilities.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav learns that anger makes him predictable.
episodes.power_progression: The shield becomes unstable when Aarav fights purely from rage.
episodes.major_reveal: Malik appears to know the truth about Aarav's connection to the ancient network.
episodes.cliffhanger: Before disappearing, Malik tells Aarav that the golden shield was never meant to awaken in him.

episodes.title: The Unchosen Heir
episodes.purpose: Challenge Aarav's belief that he was destined for the power.
plot: Aarav questions whether the legacy chose him at all.
Vedant investigates old records using information taken from Malik's complex.
Evidence suggests the sealed legacy was designed to respond to qualities rather than bloodline.
Aarav realizes that inheritance and worthiness may be different concepts.
Rahman discovers Malik is preparing to activate several resonance sites simultaneously.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav stops viewing himself as a chosen hero and begins viewing his actions as choices.
episodes.power_progression: His control improves after accepting that power does not define his identity.
episodes.major_reveal: The legacy may not depend on ancestry.
episodes.cliffhanger: Multiple dormant sites activate at exactly the same moment.

episodes.title: The Awakening
episodes.purpose: Begin the season finale arc.
plot: Resonance disturbances appear across several locations.
Unit Seven struggles to contain the events without exposing the supernatural world publicly.
Malik uses the network to locate the final component required for the second legacy.
Aarav, Vedant and Rahman form an uneasy alliance.
Aarav discovers that his shield can temporarily stabilize an unstable resonance site.
Doing so nearly causes him to collapse.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav willingly risks himself for strangers.
episodes.power_progression: The golden energy can stabilize a resonance disturbance for a short period.
episodes.major_reveal: Aarav's power may function as a key or stabilizer within the ancient network.
episodes.cliffhanger: Malik obtains the location of the final sealed chamber.

episodes.title: The Final Chamber
episodes.purpose: Bring every major Season 1 faction into the same conflict.
plot: Malik's forces, Unit Seven and Aarav converge on the final chamber.
Vedant discovers inscriptions explaining that combining incompatible divine resonances could cause catastrophic consequences.
Malik begins activating the reconstructed mechanism.
Rahman's forces attempt to stop him.
Aarav uses the golden shield at a level beyond anything previously attempted.
The chamber begins collapsing as both resonance signatures interact.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav fully accepts responsibility without believing himself invincible.
episodes.power_progression: Strongest defensive manifestation of the season, with extreme physical cost.
episodes.major_reveal: Malik does not intend simply to possess the artifacts; he wants to open something the network was designed to keep inaccessible.
episodes.cliffhanger: The mechanism activates despite their attempt to stop it.

episodes.title: The Door Beyond
episodes.purpose: Resolve the immediate Season 1 conflict while opening the larger saga.
plot: The activated mechanism creates a massive resonance event inside the chamber.
Aarav chooses to protect the others instead of pursuing Malik.
His golden shield stabilizes part of the collapsing network.
Malik fails to achieve his complete objective but escapes with crucial information.
The second divine weapon remains incomplete.
Unit Seven survives but its secrets are now vulnerable.
Vedant discovers an inscription that changes their understanding of the ancient network.
Aarav finally understands that his family's deaths were connected to a much older conflict, but not for the reason he originally believed.
The immediate resonance event is stopped.
episodes.character_progression: Aarav ends the season as a more disciplined protector while still carrying unresolved grief.
episodes.power_progression: Aarav gains reliable basic control of the golden defensive power but remains far from mastering the legacy.
episodes.season_answer: The golden legacy responds primarily to qualities of sacrifice and protective intent rather than simply to bloodline.
unresolved_mysteries: Why did Aarav uniquely trigger the ancient network?
What lies beyond the sealed system?
Who originally connected the two divine traditions?
What did Vasu know that he never revealed?
episodes.final_cliffhanger: Far beneath an unknown ancient location, something reacts to the resonance pulse. A previously unseen symbol begins glowing in the darkness.

continuity_rules.rule_1: Episodes must be generated in chronological order.
continuity_rules.rule_2: The AI must read mythology_universe.json, characters.json and this file before writing an episode.
continuity_rules.rule_3: Do not reveal future episode information early unless explicitly written as foreshadowing.
continuity_rules.rule_4: Aarav must not suddenly gain abilities scheduled for later episodes.
continuity_rules.rule_5: Malik's full identity and objective remain unresolved at the end of Season 1.
continuity_rules.rule_6: General Rahman's morality must remain complex rather than becoming a simple hero or villain.
continuity_rules.rule_7: Previously established injuries, deaths, discoveries and relationships must carry forward.
continuity_rules.rule_8: Each episode should feel like part of one continuous story rather than an independent adventure.
continuity_rules.rule_9: Mythological references should be respectful and distinguish established mythology from the fictional extensions created for this series.
